scope.wholeSource: Pinned semantic analysis and complete release gate; no claim of an independent line-by-line review of every implementation file.

findings.title: Stale auth replies overwrite newer account state
findings.evidence: Nine of ten initial controlled regressions fail before the auth/job fixes; the current-request failure control passes. Delayed lookup restores Alice after logout; a failed initial lookup clears Bob after a successful sign-in; older sign-in sets an Alice MFA challenge.

findings.title: Obsolete job attempts retain durable write capabilities
findings.evidence: Timeout, cancellation and replacement each permit both a stale database insert and child enqueue before the fix. Retained completed contexts also accept writes. Checks now validate signal, local lifetime, claim token/owner/state, cancellation and lease deadline inside the write transaction.

findings.title: Asynchronous error observers escape failure containment
findings.evidence: Two isolated backend/job regressions fail with unhandled rejections before the observer fix. Synchronous and asynchronous composite observer regressions verify that the backend observer still runs after the job observer fails.

findings.title: Workflow graph and publisher types lose their step contracts
findings.evidence: Runtime registries retain the workflow step shape; frozen builders and publishers keep contextual generic types. All 32 job-module diagnostics are removed with no new diagnostic keys/counts.

compatibility.behavior: Older operations may resolve their own responses but cannot overwrite newer client state. A stale passkey continuation fails with existing AUTH_FAILED/409 before its finish HTTP request. Obsolete job attempts receive an error when using context writes or durable publishers; active atomic fan-out remains supported.

remaining.productionHost: Current Railway host denies required Linux namespaces; no deployment certification or isolation bypass performed.
remaining.privilegedTests: XFS/Docker certification requires an explicitly disposable compatible host.
remaining.externalEffects: Client state guards do not serialize browser cookie handling. SQLite claim fences do not make unrelated remote APIs exactly once. Pass cancellation signals and idempotency keys to remote services.
remaining.otherObservers: This batch contains auth/backend/jobs observers. Other modules remain separate review targets.
